name: pointer-anchor-tap
description: a down+up pointer sequence targeting a selector's topLeft anchor classifies as a tap and dispatches at the anchored point
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pointer anchor
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- pointer:
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down:
              selector:
                id: target
              anchor: topLeft
          - up
